Vault builders still possess the full power [Sairazul](/Deities.aspx?ID=107) instilled in them, capable of creating new life and shaping the world around them. A vault builder's life span is several millennia, but their memories are preserved within a crystalline generation stone when they die to be placed inside a newly constructed vault builder body. **[Recall Knowledge - Elemental](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10)): DC 51 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 49 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 46 [Vault Builder](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2630) **Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 109 **Perception** +37; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12), [tremorsense](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=40) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 120 feet **Languages** [Orvian](/Languages.aspx?ID=120), [Petran](/Languages.aspx?ID=109); [telepathy](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=37) 300 feet **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +39, [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2) +42, [Architecture Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +42, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +39, [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) +44, [Engineering Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +42, [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) +37, [Planar Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +42, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +41, [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) +39 **Str** +8 **Dex** +10 **Con** +7 **Int** +11 **Wis** +6 **Cha** +8 **Craft Crystal Wand** ([exploration](/Traits.aspx?ID=66)) **Frequency** twice per day; **Effect** The vault builder spends 10 minutes creating a magic wand out of radioactive green crystal, containing any 8th-rank or lower [earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=55) spell of their choice. The wand can be used by other creatures, but it crumbles to sand at the end of the day and has no monetary value. The vault builder can expend both daily uses to instead make a _+3 [greater striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [major staff of earth](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2261)_.
**Item Caster** The vault builder can Cast a Spell from any item (such as a staff or wand) as though it were on their spell list, but the spell can be 8th-rank or lower. --- **AC** 47 **Fort** +36 **Ref** +41 **Will** +35 +1 status to all saves vs. spells ( +4 status vs. [earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=55)) **HP** 465 **Immunities** bleed, [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=28), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), [radiation](/Traits.aspx?ID=421), [sleep](/Traits.aspx?ID=145) **Resistances** physical 20 (except [adamantine](/Equipment.aspx?ID=374)) **[Reactive Strike](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=48)** --- **Speed** 35 feet, burrow 25 feet, climb 35 feet; earth glide **Melee** crystal staff +39 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Radiation](/Traits.aspx?ID=421), [two-hand d8](/Traits.aspx?ID=198)), **Damage** 4d4+12 bludgeoning plus 4d6 poison **Melee** crystal wand +37 ([Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Radiation](/Traits.aspx?ID=421)), **Damage** 4d4+12 piercing plus 4d6 poison **Melee** claw +37 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103)), **Damage** 5d10+12 slashing plus constraining crystal **Ranged** crystal shard +37 ([Earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=55), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [range increment 100 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)), **Damage** 7d6+4 piercing **Arcane Prepared Spells** DC 50, attack +42 - **Cantrips (10th)** [Detect Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=66), [Read Aura](/Spells.aspx?ID=246), [Scatter Scree](/Spells.aspx?ID=990), [Sigil](/Spells.aspx?ID=286), [Mage Hand](/Spells.aspx?ID=177) - **1st** [Ant Haul](/Spells.aspx?ID=13), [Quick Sort](/Spells.aspx?ID=978) (×2) - **2nd** [Knock](/Spells.aspx?ID=168), [Magnetic Attraction](/Spells.aspx?ID=944), [Magnetic Repulsion](/Spells.aspx?ID=945) - **3rd** [Meld into Stone](/Spells.aspx?ID=188) (×2), [Mending](/Spells.aspx?ID=189) - **4th** [Clairvoyance](/Spells.aspx?ID=40), [Engrave Memory](/Spells.aspx?ID=1330), [Grasping Earth](/Spells.aspx?ID=1334) - **5th** [Blazing Fissure](/Spells.aspx?ID=870), [Creation](/Spells.aspx?ID=54), [See Invisibility](/Spells.aspx?ID=271) - **6th** [Pave Ground](/Spells.aspx?ID=1338), [Flesh to Stone](/Spells.aspx?ID=123), [Wall of Force](/Spells.aspx?ID=363) - **7th** [Fly](/Spells.aspx?ID=125), [Haste](/Spells.aspx?ID=147) (×2) - **8th** [Earthquake](/Spells.aspx?ID=95) (×2), [Stoneskin](/Spells.aspx?ID=312) - **9th** [Disintegrate](/Spells.aspx?ID=76) (×2), [Heaving Earth](/Spells.aspx?ID=1335) **Arcane Innate Spells** DC 50, attack +42 - **4th** [Earthbind](/Spells.aspx?ID=94) (at will), [Shape Stone](/Spells.aspx?ID=276) (at will), [Dimension Door](/Spells.aspx?ID=69) (at will) - **8th** [Flesh to Stone](/Spells.aspx?ID=123), [Scrying](/Spells.aspx?ID=268), [Shatter](/Spells.aspx?ID=279) (at will), [Stone Tell](/Spells.aspx?ID=310) (at will), [Teleport](/Spells.aspx?ID=338), [Dimension Door](/Spells.aspx?ID=69) - **10th** [Summon Elemental](/Spells.aspx?ID=320) (earth only), [Wall of Stone](/Spells.aspx?ID=365) **Constraining Crystal** ([Earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=55), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103)) When the vault builder deals damage with a claw Strike, glowing green crystals cluster at the site of the attack. The target must succeed at a DC 31 Fortitude save or become [clumsy 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=3) for 1 hour (or clumsy 2 on a critical failure). If the creature is already clumsy due to constraining crystal, additional failures increase that clumsy value instead, to a maximum of clumsy 4. A target that fails its save while clumsy 4 is [petrified](/Conditions.aspx?ID=30) with an unlimited duration. **Crystal Burst** ([Arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [Earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=55)) An explosion of razor-sharp splinters deals 24d6 piercing damage in a 30-foot burst within 120 feet, with a DC 46 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save. The vault builder can't use Crystal Burst again for 1d4 rounds. **Earth Glide** The vault builder can [Burrow](/Actions.aspx?ID=93) through any earthen matter, including rock. When they do so, the vault builder moves at their full burrow Speed, leaving no tunnels or signs of their passing.
